pairs.ask: Password Manager + Passkeys On Email, GitHub, Stripe, Registrar: Do This Week, Or Schedule Later? (cisa.gov/MFA)

optionA.label: This Week
optionA.desc: Account takeover is the top path to losing the company.

optionB.label: Schedule Later
optionB.desc: Higher risk window while public apps stay live.

pairs.ask: Hardware Keys Or Passkeys: Add Two Keys And Turn Off SMS Fallback, Or Passkeys Only For Now? (NIST SP 800-63B)

optionA.label: Two Hardware Keys + No SMS
optionA.desc: Phishing-resistant; SMS fallback is weaker.

optionB.label: Passkeys Only First
optionB.desc: Faster; add hardware keys on the next trip.

pairs.ask: Recovery Codes: Print And Store Offline This Week, Or Digital Vault Only? (GitHub 2FA recovery docs)

optionA.label: Print Offline
optionA.desc: Lost key without codes locks you out of the company.

optionB.label: Digital Vault Only
optionB.desc: Convenient; single point of failure if the vault is lost.

pairs.ask: Agent Tokens: Fine-Grained PATs Per Repo With 30-90 Day Expiry, Or Keep Broader Tokens? (GitHub PAT docs)

optionA.label: Fine-Grained, Expiring
optionA.desc: An agent token with publish rights is a skeleton key.

optionB.label: Broader For Now
optionB.desc: Less friction for agents; higher blast radius.

pairs.ask: Human Approval Before Public Publish, Email Or Payment: Keep Strict, Or Trust Agent Drafts To Ship? (OWASP LLM Top 10)

optionA.label: Keep Strict Approval
optionA.desc: Prompt injection and excessive agency are real (LLM01, LLM06).

optionB.label: Trust More Autopilot
optionB.desc: Faster; higher hijack risk on web/email reads.

pairs.ask: Secret Scanning + Push Protection On All Repos: Turn On Now, Or Audit First? (GitHub secret scanning)

optionA.label: Turn On Now
optionA.desc: Pages repos are public; committed secrets are forever.

optionB.label: Audit First
optionB.desc: Scan, clean, then enable; short delay.

pairs.ask: Branch Protection On Main For Customer Apps: Require Reviews, Or Allow Agent Direct Push?

optionA.label: Protect Main
optionA.desc: Limits damage from a compromised collaborator or agent.

optionB.label: Allow Direct Push
optionB.desc: Faster ship; weaker control on smart-upkeep.

pairs.ask: Payments: Stripe Hosted Checkout Or Elements Only, Or Custom Card Forms? (docs.stripe.com/security)

optionA.label: Hosted Checkout Or Elements
optionA.desc: Keeps cards off your systems; SAQ A scope.

optionB.label: Custom Card Forms
optionB.desc: Never preferred; expands PCI scope.

pairs.ask: Customer Data Minimization: List Every Field And Delete Unneeded Before Launch, Or Collect Now And Prune Later? (FTC PPI guide)

optionA.label: Minimize Before Launch
optionA.desc: Data you do not hold cannot be breached.

optionB.label: Collect Now, Prune Later
optionB.desc: Faster experiments; larger breach surface.

pairs.ask: Privacy Policy On smartupkeep.ai: Publish Matching Real Collection Before Launch Ads, Or After First Paid Member? (FTC privacy)

optionA.label: Before Launch Ads
optionA.desc: FTC treats privacy promises as deceptive-practice risk.

optionB.label: After First Paid Member
optionB.desc: Risky if ads already describe data use.

pairs.ask: Michigan Breach Notice (MCL 445.72): Write A One-Page Incident Plan Now, Or When Legal Finishes Drafts?

optionA.label: Write The One-Pager Now
optionA.desc: Who to call and a notice template; Legal can refine.

optionB.label: Wait For Legal Drafts
optionB.desc: More complete; gap until then.

pairs.ask: Repo Backups: Weekly Mirror To Offline Or Dropbox, Or Rely On GitHub Alone? (CISA Cyber Essentials)

optionA.label: Weekly Mirror
optionA.desc: Recovery from deletion or ransomware.

optionB.label: GitHub Alone
optionB.desc: Simpler; single provider risk.

pairs.ask: Walk-Through App Privacy: Approve Construction Fix (Remove Public Address And Entry Notes), Or Hold?

optionA.label: Approve The Fix
optionA.desc: Founder brief flagged public address, name and entry instructions in walk-app.

optionB.label: Hold For Now
optionB.desc: Needs Max OK; do not touch the live app until approved.

pairs.ask: Niko Home Guide During Security Passes: Never Move Relock Or Change, Or Rotate Password With Max OK?

optionA.label: Never Change Without Explicit OK
optionA.desc: Standing Max rule: live customer apps stay put during URL or password work.

optionB.label: Rotate With Max OK Only
optionB.desc: Still requires Max OK; Construction owns the change.

pairs.ask: smartupkeep.ai During Security Work: UpKeep-Only Edits Continue, Or Freeze Publishes Until Passkeys Done?

optionA.label: UpKeep Edits Continue
optionA.desc: Pre-launch free publish rule still on until launch.

optionB.label: Freeze Non-Essential Publishes
optionB.desc: Shrink change window while founder MFA lands.

pairs.ask: Contractor IP: NDA Plus Written Assignment Before More Helpers, Or Informal For Now? (copyright.gov circ 30)

optionA.label: NDA Plus Assignment
optionA.desc: Without assignment, contractors may own code they wrote.

optionB.label: Informal For Now
optionB.desc: Faster short tasks; IP risk grows.

pairs.ask: Trademark: Start USPTO Search For Smart Upkeep Now, Or After Name Is Final? (uspto.gov trademarks)

optionA.label: Start Search Now
optionA.desc: Legal already tracks paid search questions.

optionB.label: After Name Final
optionB.desc: Avoid spend if the name changes.

pairs.ask: GitHub Security Log Review: Monthly Habit, Or Only After An Incident?

optionA.label: Monthly Habit
optionA.desc: Visibility into what agents and collaborators did.

optionB.label: After An Incident
optionB.desc: Less overhead; slower detection.

pairs.ask: Collaborator Audit: Quarterly Access Review, Or Continuous As Agents Join?

optionA.label: Quarterly Review
optionA.desc: Matches founder brief item 6.

optionB.label: Continuous As Agents Join
optionB.desc: Tighter; more process noise.

pairs.ask: Security Agent Reporting: Keep Direct To Grok Bot (Not Inside AIR), Or Fold Into AIR Later?

optionA.label: Keep Direct To Grok Bot
optionA.desc: Max rule Oct 14; Security is not in AIR.

optionB.label: Revisit After MFA Hardening
optionB.desc: Only if Max changes the org chart.
